FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Trendy Threads Boutique operates as a retail and wholesale clothing store specializing in on-trend apparel for men, women, and children. Our operations focus on sourcing high-quality garments from verified suppliers while maintaining a balanced inventory valued at under $500,000 to minimize the risk of theft and loss. We engage in a limited online sales strategy that makes up less than 75% of our total revenue, allowing us to effectively manage fulfillment and reduce cyber risks. The store also provides minor tailoring services, which comprise less than 10% of our overall business activities, ensuring we remain compliant with liability limitations. Located in a secure shopping area, Trendy Threads emphasizes exceptional customer service, efficient inventory management, and adherence to all labor and safety regulations while fostering a trendy shopping environment. Our operations aim to provide quality apparel while mitigating risks associated with high-value inventory and online sales.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not exceed an inventory value of $500,000 and confirms that a central alarm system is not required. Additionally, online sales constitute less than 75% of total revenue, and repair or alteration services make up less than 10% of our business activity. We confidently affirm compliance with all specified conditions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss described: On March 5, 2023, theft of merchandise during store hours, resulting in a loss of $1,200. Status: resolved with insurance reimbursement. Additionally, on July 10, 2023, water damage from a leaky roof caused $600 in damage, which has been repaired. Total losses: $1,800.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty steel safe, UL fire-rated, grade 1, for cash and merchandise.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with motion sensors and security patrols during non-operating hours.
